central_result: R12B did not merely deduplicate a completed derivation graph. It changed the search representation so that derivation histories collapse immediately into canonical content states, and semantically dominated states are removed before further derivation.

representation_contract_interpretation.target_invariant: exact bridge interface / witness-preserving forbidden structure
representation_contract_interpretation.representation: minimal basis of canonical forbidden partial patterns / width<=4 clauses
representation_contract_interpretation.content_equivalence: different derivation histories producing the same canonical clause/pattern are one state
representation_contract_interpretation.semantic_dominance: if C is a stronger forbidden clause than D under subsumption, D is not a separate decision-relevant active state
representation_contract_interpretation.why_valid_here: The frozen candidate reproduced both exact allowed sets with FP=0 and FN=0 and recovered all exact prime implicates for both exposed interfaces.
representation_contract_interpretation.claim_boundary: This validates the representation on the two frozen worlds; it does not prove arbitrary-CNF completeness or a global polynomial transition bound.

width_interpretation.observed: R10 required a width-5 Davis-Putnam path, while R12B reproduced the same final interfaces without creating width>4 candidate states.
width_interpretation.allowed_claim: For these two frozen worlds, width 5 was a cost of the earlier compilation path rather than a demonstrated necessity of the final interface representation.
width_interpretation.forbidden_claim: Width 4 is universally sufficient for arbitrary CNF.

not_yet_proved: that arbitrary CNF closure remains complete at fixed k=4
that the number of useful transitions/pair attempts is polynomially bounded
that active-basis maintenance is polynomial over all inputs under the required correctness invariant
that unseen interfaces preserve the same exactness behavior
that the resulting end-to-end SAT procedure is polynomial

deepest_methodological_update: The computational opportunity is not ordinary duplicate removal. It is changing the representation before search so that syntactic path multiplicity never becomes distinct decision-state multiplicity unless it changes the invariant.
canonical_seal: R12B TURNED A POST-HOC DEDUPLICATION IDEA INTO A SEARCH REPRESENTATION. THE RESULT IS REAL ON TWO FROZEN WORLDS: EXACT INTERFACES EMERGED FROM THE QUOTIENT WITHOUT WIDTH 5. THE NEXT QUESTION IS NOT WHETHER THE OLD WORLDS MATCH AGAIN; IT IS WHETHER A BYTE-FROZEN COMPILER SURVIVES UNSEEN WORLDS WITH EXACTNESS AND A DEFENSIBLE SCALING LAW.
